focus: Members on the top tier could not open the classified archive — in fact nobody signed in could, because the page behind it was erroring for everyone. That is fixed and checked against the live site, not just the code. We also closed a gap where our own records could say a fix was live without anything having verified it; now only an automatic check can make that claim.
nextStep: Next, one real sign-in test finishes the proof on the new single sign-on, and then the finished improvements can go live.
